_comment: Distinct barrier states. Normalization must NEVER merge verified with not_verified or any other state. These six states are the closed set (PRD section 7C).

barrier_states.label: Not Verified
barrier_states.description: Barrier not confirmed/checked before work progressed.

barrier_states.label: Failed
barrier_states.description: Barrier was present but failed during the event.

barrier_states.label: Partially Effective
barrier_states.description: Barrier present but only partly effective.

barrier_states.label: Absent
barrier_states.description: Barrier not present / not in place / removed.

barrier_states.label: Unknown
barrier_states.description: State could not be determined from the narrative.
